app: In Cloudflare Zero Trust (one.dash.cloudflare.com) go to Settings > Authentication > Login methods and choose Add new > OIDC.
Name the login method (e.g. "FlareID") and paste the App ID / Client ID {client_id} and Client secret {client_secret} from the FlareID client you created.
Set Auth URL to {idp_authorize_url}, Token URL to {idp_token_url} and Certificate URL to {idp_jwks_url}.
Save, then press Test on the login method - Access redeems a code and shows the claims it received.
Add the login method to the Access policies where it should be offered (check your app's current UI).
flareid: Create an OIDC client (Admin > Applications > OIDC clients > New) and apply this template: a confidential client with redirect URI https://{team}.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback.
Replace {team} with your Zero Trust team name - it is shown under Settings > General > Team name in the Cloudflare dashboard.
Keep the email and profile claims enabled: Access identifies users by the email claim. Enable groups if Access policies should match FlareID group names (the 'groups' claim).
Copy the generated client_id and client_secret into the Access login method before pressing Test.
